capabilities: Render aa code blocks with MS PGothic at 12pt
Disable kerning and ligatures to preserve art alignment
Scroll long lines horizontally instead of wrapping
Apply the font to lines inside blocks in Live Preview and source mode
Insert aa blocks or wrap selections via a command palette command
extras: MS PGothic is a Windows-only font; on macOS or Linux users must install an AA font such as IPAMonaPGothic or Mona and set it in the plugin settings, though these are included as fallbacks by default.
problem: Obsidian's default code block font, line height and line wrapping distort 2ch-style Japanese ASCII art, which needs MS PGothic at 12pt with fixed metrics to display correctly.
summary: Code block renderer that displays aa-fenced blocks in MS PGothic 12pt so Japanese 2ch-style ASCII art keeps its original shape.
